title: spec(page:header): an explicit opt-in to draw every action placed at record_header / record_more, read live (#29951 ruling A, spec half)
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjDyeFwq6AuFu3vwTd

Ruling-ref: 6624172200 (#29951, letter A, maintainer 「以上同意」 2026-11-04T06:22Z)

**The spec half of #29951's ruling A.** Contract first: the ui half (#29951, card thread on `claude/project-thread-4y2o5l`) waits for this to land.

**Reader:** `domain:spec` (`packages/spec`, the `page:header` component props).

## Wanted

- `@objectstack/spec` adds **one explicit opt-in on `page:header`**: draw every action of the bound object that is placed at `record_header` / `record_more`, read live, in place of an authored id list.
- The authored `actions` list keeps its #11592 meaning: an authored list is the whole set. The new key is the other, explicit way to say "all placed actions".
- **Spelling and exclusivity with `actions`** (e.g. a refusal when both are set) are this seat's call. Name both in the PR so the maintainer sees them.
- `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` **minor**. Nothing ships in 18.3.x for this (maintainer amendment 「18.3.x 不发」「等后续发版的时候再写说明」, 2026-11-04T06:24Z): the release note is written with the notes of the release that carries A.
- Usual spec ripples: the authorable surface, docs and skills where `page:header` props are taught.

## Not in this card

- The ui reader, and the three platform pages #27219 froze (`sys_user_detail`, `sys_organization_detail`, `sys_approval_request_detail`) switching to the opt-in. Those are `domain:ui`, #29951, after this lands.
- Not taken by the ruling: B (list meaning by source package), C (back to `slotted`), D alone.

Graded p1: it unblocks the fix for a shipped 18.3.0 regression (#29951).

Links: #29951 (ruling 6624172200, decision 6611296943), #27219, #11592, duly#185.
